name: Salatan
source:
After a strange day at school, you begin to realize nothing around you is what it seems. Unraveling a hidden truth comes at a price: remembering who you really are. A psychological horror visual novel about identity, memory, and the cost of survival.

[From [url=https://rainslices.itch.io/salatan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在学校度过了奇怪的一天后，你开始意识到周围的一切都不像看上去的那样。揭开隐藏的真相是有代价的：记住你到底是谁。一部关于身份、记忆和生存成本的心理恐怖视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://rainslices.itch.io/salatan]Itch.io[/url]]
